虔诚（虔诚（第22页）本命法器，那是需要用自身性命来蕴养的。同一柄法器，蜕变为本命法器之后战力会大幅提升，且本命法器提升越高，战力增幅越大，当然，一旦本命法器受损，修士自身也会重伤。九命涅轮乃是超脱灵道的法宝，若炼制成他的本命法器，实力会暴涨，但问题是，这件法宝不能在其他人面前显露。太虚剑也可以，但却只是伪灵道法宝，而本命法器只能有一件，一旦确定，想要解绑会非常麻烦，所以他一直在考虑最起码得找到灵道法宝再炼制本命法宝最好。好在，苍鸿摇头道：“你如今只是人道修士，限制没那么多，只需使用你常用的法宝即可。”听罢，沈长青顿时松了一口气，随即取出一柄上品法剑。“往你的法器内注入阳金真意，并吟诵颂词。”见此，苍鸿顿时道：“真君虚影的实力乃是根据修炼者本身的修为来的，且其更多的是一种真意交流，所以无需担心自己会在修炼之中受伤。”沈长青没有废话，立马向着法剑内注入一缕阳金真意，随后又学着苍鸿先前的话吟诵了起来。“金精西极，太白为名。”“唯兵为凭，唯意为旌。”“我今持此，召君之灵。”“敢请真君，砺我真形。”然而，颂词吟诵完毕之后，预想中的场景却并未出现，甚至没有一丝变化。“这……”沈长青愕然，本以为是颂词错了，可再吟诵一遍之后依旧没有反应，他这才确定肯定是其他地方出现了问题。“你不虔诚！”苍鸿的声音突然在他耳边响起，“你对太白真君没有敬畏之心！”沈长青懵了，什么玩意儿，修炼这个请兵法还得有敬畏与虔诚之心？可他对一个未来极有可能要弄死自己的人怎么可能保有虔诚之心？！“这庚金一道的修士怕都是一群信徒！”沈长青恍然想起，难怪那些净土使者此前提起那位东山圣女的时候会无比的崇拜，想来怕是与这修炼法有关。“罢了。”这时，苍鸿却是无所谓的摆了摆手，道：“毕竟你也修不到灵台境，所以即便掌握不了这请兵法也无妨。”沈长青连忙问道：“我记得前辈先前说过，只要在真意环境中，即便不用这请兵法也可以修炼吧？”他有，或将可以掌握多种真意，因此很担心其他真意法是不是也需要像这庚金一道需要对真君保持虔诚之心。“确实如此。”苍鸿倒也没隐瞒，开口道：“事实上，在真意环境之中使用真意修炼法来修炼效果会更好，只不过……”他看了沈长青一眼，略带讽刺的笑了一声，“净土大世的真意环境皆被顶级势力把持，甚至是那些还未真正出世的真意环境在出世之前就已经被那些大能提前算到并占据。”“而这等宝地，即便是老夫一年也难以享受一次，何况是你……”苍鸿离开了。沈长青独自站在房间中央，心情却丝毫没有被对方影响，因为，掌控了太初清炁的他，完全可以自己创造真意环境！而且是想要什么环境就能创造什么环境！

Piety (Piety (page 22)) natal magic weapon, which needs to be cultivated by one's own life. The combat power of the same magic weapon will be greatly improved after transforming into a natal magic weapon, and the higher the improvement of the natal magic weapon, the greater the increase in combat power. Of course, once the natal magic weapon is damaged, the monk himself will also be seriously injured. The nine-life nirvana is a magic weapon that transcends the spiritual path. If it is refined into his natal magic weapon, his strength will skyrocket, but the problem is that this magic weapon cannot be used in the spiritual world. It was revealed in front of others. The Taixu Sword is also available, but it is only a pseudo-spiritual magic weapon, and there can only be one natal magic weapon. Once it is determined, it will be very troublesome to unbind it, so he has been thinking that it would be best to at least find the spiritual magic weapon and then refine the natal magic weapon. Fortunately, Cang Hong shook his head and said, "You are only a humane monk now, and there are not so many restrictions. You only need to use the magic weapon you commonly use." After hearing this, Shen Changqing breathed a sigh of relief, and then He immediately took out a high-grade magic sword and said, "Inject the true meaning of Yang Jin into your magic weapon and recite the hymn." Seeing this, Cang Hong immediately said: "The strength of Zhenjun Xuying is based on the cultivator's own cultivation, and it is more of an exchange of true meaning, so there is no need to worry about being injured during practice." Shen Changqing didn't waste any time, and immediately injected a ray of true meaning of Yang Gold into the magic sword, and then imitated Cang Hong's previous words and chanted. "The golden spirit is in the west, and its name is Taibai." "Only the soldiers are the basis, and the only intention is the banner." "I hold this now to summon the spirit of the king." "Dare to ask the true king to sharpen my true form." However, after the hymn was recited, the expected scene But it didn't appear, not even a trace of change. "This..." Shen Changqing was stunned. He originally thought that the eulogy was wrong, but after reciting it again, there was still no response. Then he was sure that there must be a problem somewhere else. "You are not pious!" Cang Hong's voice suddenly sounded in his ears, "You have no respect for True Lord Taibai!" Shen Changqing was confused. What the hell, practicing this art of war requires a sense of awe and piety? But how can he maintain a pious heart towards a person who is very likely to kill him in the future?! "I'm afraid these monks from Gengjin are all a group of believers!" Shen Changqing suddenly remembered that no wonder those Pure Land envoys had mentioned it before. When she was young, she would admire the Saintess of Dongshan so much. I think it has something to do with this cultivation method. "That's all." At this time, Cang Hong waved his hands indifferently and said: "After all, you can't cultivate to the Lingtai realm, so it doesn't matter even if you can't master the art of war." Shen Changqing asked quickly: "I remember that the senior said before that as long as you are in a true environment, you can practice without this art of war, right?" He has, or will be able to master many kinds of war. True meaning, so I am worried that other true meaning methods also need to maintain a pious heart towards the true king like this Geng Jin. "It is true." Cang Hong did not hide it, and said: "In fact, it will be better to use the true meaning cultivation method in the true meaning environment, but..." He glanced at Shen Changqing and smiled slightly sarcastically, "The true meaning environment of the Pure Land is controlled by the top forces, even those who have not yet seen it. The true meaning environment that was truly born has been calculated and occupied by those powerful people before it was born. "And this kind of treasure land, even I can't enjoy it once a year, let alone you..." Cang Hong left. Shen Changqing stood alone in the center of the room, but his mood was not affected by the other party at all, because, having controlled Taichu Qingqi, he can create the true meaning environment by himself! And he can create any environment he wants!
